newsitem.title: UK: Kingfisher says 9-week sales up 7.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kingfisher says 9-week sales up 7.8 pct.

text.p: British retail group Kingfisher Plc said on Wedneseday like-for-like sales rose 7.8 percent in the nine weeks to January 4, 1997.
The company said total retail sales were up 11.7 percent at 1.464 billion pounds.
Kingfisher said sales at Woolworths were up 9.0 percent, or up 8.1 percent on a like-for-like basis, helped by strong sales of Christmas products, toys and home essentials.

At electrical goods retailer Comet, like-for-like sales were up 14 percent and home improvement chain B&Q saw sales rise 10.5 percent on a like-for-like basis. B&Q's total sales were up 13.9 percent, Kingfisher said.

Sales at drugs and personal care products retailer Superdrug rose five percent on a like-for-like basis while total sales were up 7.6 percent. At Darty, Kingfisher's French electrical retailer, sales in local currency terms were up 4.7 percent after adjusting for 8.0 million pounds of sales from New Vanden Borre. Like-for-like sales were up 2.4 percent.
